subject: Executive pre-brief + split demo window — CTO/VP availability
messages:
From: Elliot Harper <elliot.harper@auroragrid.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen.park@auroragrid.com>, procurement@auroragrid.com
Date: 2029-12-03T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Exec presence for next-week demo?

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the quick follow. AuroraGrid is keen to see the platform in action, but this one is an exec-level decision so we need CTO + VP presence for the kickoff. Rough ask: 45 minutes total (15 min exec intro, 30 min demo + Q&A).

Quick context: CTO wants a short technical alignment (architecture, data flows, security guardrails). VP is focused on cost/ops and will only do ~20–30 minutes. Availability constraints: CTO is on call mornings Mon–Thu, but has a midday window 11:30–12:30 PST next Tue/Wed. VP is travelling and has open blocks after 15:00 PST next Tue–Thu. Can you propose a plan that gets both covered without blocking a full hour of their calendars?

Also attaching a one-pager of our goals (see Aurora-demo-deck-v2.pdf).

Best,
Elliot

Attachments: Aurora-demo-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Harper <elliot.harper@auroragrid.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-12-03T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec presence for next-week demo?

Hi Elliot —

Thanks for the color and the deck — helpful. Short proposal to accommodate both execs without asking them to overlap for a full hour:

- Option A (split): 11:30–12:00 PST — CTO technical pre-brief (30m).
  - Followed by 15:30–16:00 PST — VP-focused demo highlight + commercial Q&A (30m).
  - Redwood attendees: I can host both sessions; Markus will join the VP session for cost/ops and Sofia will cover technical questions if the CTO needs deeper lane coverage.

- Option B (compressed same-hour): 11:30–12:15 PST — 45m block where CTO joins first 30m and VP joins last 20m. This requires a small overlap choreography but keeps it to one invite.

If you prefer Option A we can send two calendar invites and a short handoff note between sessions. I attached a proposed exec agenda (Exec-Agenda-proposal.docx) — would you like us to slide in specific cost artifacts for the VP session?

Quick ask: which option is more likely to get approvals from your side? If you confirm Option A I’ll loop Markus and Sofia in for the two invites and propose times next Tue/Wed.

Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Exec-Agenda-proposal.docx

From: Helen Park <helen.park@auroragrid.com>

Cc: procurement@auroragrid.com
Date: 2029-12-03T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec presence for next-week demo?

Thanks, Mina —

Option A is cleaner for us operationally (two focused slots). A couple notes from scheduling:

- CTO confirmed 11:30–12:00 PST on Wednesday (2029-12-04) as the only firm midday window.
- VP can do 15:30–16:00 PST on Tuesday (2029-12-03) or Thursday (2029-12-05).
- Procurement: we are beginning standard review for pilot terms; procurement@auroragrid.com is on this thread for contracting cadence.

Elliot — does Tuesday 15:30 PST work for the VP? If so we can lock both invites (Wed 11:30 CTO, Tue 15:30 VP) and ask Redwood to provide a 5–10 minute handoff note so both execs have context.

Helen

Thanks for the heads-up, team. I can cover the VP session Tuesday 15:30 PST and will prepare a 10-min commercial summary + ROI snapshot for their time. Sofia, can you draft 3 talking points for the CTO pre-brief (latency/kv-cache, private deployment options, and an ops runbook example)?

Mina — if you want the cleanest experience for AuroraGrid, I vote Option A with two invites. We should:
- Reserve two calendar events with clear titles: "AuroraGrid — CTO technical pre-brief (Redwood)" and "AuroraGrid — VP ops + cost highlights (Redwood)"
- Add a one-line handoff in the CTO event notes: "Follow-up demo for VP: Tue 15:30 PST — see agenda link"
- Confirm the internal runbook owner (Sofia) for post-demo follow-ups.

I’ll annotate the ROI slide with the VP’s cost levers and bring an engineering backup for any deep-dive.

-Markus
